title: Tune Main Display weather bounds and render measured pressure arrows
purpose: Apply the operator's bounded Main Display visual correction: reduce the painted bounds of the existing six-state weather illustrations while keeping them legible, moderately enlarge the CLEAR sun disk inside that reduced composition, and replace the main-card Unicode pressure glyphs with measured Canvas/Path arrows without changing WeatherCapability pressure semantics or any neighboring capability.
success_outcome: After TASK-027, Main Display shows the existing CLEAR, CLOUD, NEUTRAL_CLOUD, RAIN, SNOW and MOON illustrations in smaller measured painted envelopes, with a moderately larger CLEAR sun disk, and renders visible UP/DOWN pressure arrows only when the existing projection supplies a non-zero count; fresh bounds/contact-sheet evidence proves non-overlap, preserved four-card/order/Today/content/day-night/stale semantics, explicit arrow stroke visibility and zero-arrow absence, while WeatherCapability.kt and all provider/network/audio/timer behavior remain unchanged.
anti_goals: Do not add a partly-cloudy composite or any new WeatherIllustration state; preserve exactly CLEAR, CLOUD, NEUTRAL_CLOUD, RAIN, SNOW and MOON.

Do not change WeatherCapability.kt, pressureDirection calculation, pressureArrowCount thresholds/fallback, pressure history, provider selection/dispatch, cache/history, freshness, refresh cadence, day/night source or normalized WeatherIllustration/moonPhase inputs.

Do not change the four-card yesterday/today/tomorrow/day_after order, Today sizing, temperature/date/content layout, temperature palette, shared static pseudo-glass, stale/first-run empty cards or forecast-card composition.
Do not keep Unicode or TextView glyph rendering for Main Display pressure arrows; do not change the separate forecast illustration text path.
Do not add resources, assets, dependencies, modules, public contracts, graph edges, provider calls, network access, credentials, persistence, lifecycle, timer or audio behavior.

Do not modify TASK-004, TASK-018, TASK-020, TASK-023, TASK-024, TASK-025, TASK-026 or TASK-027 status, identity, evidence/history, scheduler checkpoint, lifecycle/RTM state, terminal state or promotion decisions.

emulator/device launch, adb, live network/provider calls, credentials and secret-bearing artifacts
new module, dependency, public contract, graph edge, event/message path or composition-root business orchestration

A reduced icon composition cannot preserve recognizable six-state legibility within the existing Canvas/Path/Paint route; stop and route to /feature-doctor FT-002 rather than adding a partly-cloudy state or asset pipeline.

The result needs an absolute product geometry decision beyond the accepted reduce-bounds/moderate-sun adjustment, a new owner, public contract, graph edge, dependency or module; stop and route to /feature-doctor FT-002 or /spec-design as applicable.

A pressure arrow requires changing WeatherCapability pressureDirection/pressureArrowCount calculation or pressure-history ownership; stop and route to /feature-to-tasks FT-002 instead of crossing the hard boundary.
Fresh host/static/image evidence cannot distinguish the current oversized/Unicode baseline from claim-equivalent reduced/Path GREEN; preserve the task open and do not substitute target-device PASS.
Any production or test write falls outside DisplayCapability.kt or DisplayProjectionTest.kt, or any workflow action would change lifecycle, scheduler, checkpoint or terminal state.

constraints: Main Display is the primary owner of the visual composition and consumes the existing Main Display → Weather Context read projection; no raw provider field, private Weather Context state or Settings secret is accessible from this task.

FT-002-AC-009 remains the sole feature-AC owner for this follow-up; no new feature AC is created. TASK-025 remains historical baseline evidence, while this W25 card owns only the accepted visual adjustment delta under the same AC locator.

For fresh 223×444 small-card and 279×444 Today measurements, each final six-state painted illustration envelope must be at most 90% of the corresponding fresh W25 pre-change baseline in both width and height, remain inside its illustration envelope, and retain a qualitative recognizability/contrast pass. The CLEAR central sun disk must be 1.15–1.30× its fresh baseline diameter while the complete CLEAR painted envelope still meets the reduced-bounds rule.

Pressure arrows must be drawn with Canvas/Path primitives in the existing pressure content bounds, with a measured stroke width of 4–8 px at the 223×444 row-card geometry, rounded cap/join, separate shaft/head path segments, visible non-background pixels for UP and DOWN, and no drawn arrow pixels when count is zero.

Render exactly the projection-provided pressureArrowCount clamped to the existing 0–2 display range and direction; WeatherCapability remains the sole owner of pressureDirection/pressureArrowCount calculation, threshold/fallback semantics and history ownership.

Preserve four-card order, Today larger sizing, equal non-Today sizing, date/temperature/pressure non-overlap, temperature palette, shared static pseudo-glass, city-timezone day/night and moon fallback, unknown-condition neutral cloud, stale/first-run no-illustration behavior and no visible day/weather labels.

Use only existing project-native Android primitives and gates. Do not add app resources, drawable assets, a dependency, network/provider action, credential path, persistence or lifecycle state. The separate forecast-card Unicode illustration path remains outside this task.
